title: Between the lines
description: A curved ribbon of text can be dragged by hand or advanced with a range.
useCase: Create a distinctive, directly controllable typographic brand accent.
reducedMotion: Live reduced-motion preferences remove interpolation and decorative playback. All content and native controls remain available. Keyboard changes settle immediately.
limitations: Original demonstration content; adapt labels and state to the host product.
look: Flat coral-orange field crossed by a thick wavy violet ribbon carrying white Georgia serif text, with a drop shadow and a violet range slider beneath.
motion: Dragging across the ribbon or moving the slider slides the text along the curved path one-to-one, clamped at both ends; it never scrolls on its own.
adapt: Position is the `offset` state, applied as the `textPath` `startOffset` and clamped to `-300` to `60` in `onPointerMove` and the range input; the curve is the `path` in `defs`. Replace the repeated phrase, ribbon stroke colour and curve.
